Only 22% of active remote listings disclose a salary figure. That means 78% of jobs don't tell you the pay upfront.

We analyzed 4,269 active remote USD jobs on Loker Dollar. Here's what the data shows:

- 939 listings (22%) state a salary. The rest are silent.
- 2,725 listings (64%) are open to applicants anywhere in the world.
- High pay examples: OpenAI Data Scientist (USD 293,000–325,000/yr) and Equinix Chief of Staff (USD 195,000–319,000/yr).
- AI skills appear in 12% of listings, while communication is required in 39%.

Don't chase 'average' pay. Target the transparent 22% where the range is explicit.

Visit the Loker Dollar board, filter for 'USD salary disclosed,' and apply before the 7-day freshness window closes.

Read the full analysis: https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/best-remote-usd-jobs
